543.name: CODE-E
543.summary: Chinami Ebihara is a high school student who emits electromagnetic waves when her emotions run wild. The waves affect electronics such as cell phones, televisions and computers. Her ability forces her family to move from one location to another. In the year 2017, the Ebihara family moves yet again. At school, a boy named Kotaro Kannagi notices her ability and asks if he can study her. Kotaro's interest in Chinami is met with jealousy and misunderstanding by Kotaro's childhood friend, Kujo Sonomi.

enrichment.description: Code-E is a Japanese anime television series animated by Studio DEEN. It is based on an original concept by Ichiro Sakaki and directed by Toshiyuki Katō. The first season consists of twelve episodes and first aired in Japan on July 3, 2007 to September 23, 2007. A second season titled Mission-E began airing in July 2008. A new lead character named Maori Kimizuka will be joining Chinami in the sequel.

540.name: [Dub] Magical Witch Punie Chan
540.summary: On the outside, Punie-chan looks like your average magical girl. She's a cheery princess from another land, she's attending school on Earth for the year, and she has an adorable animal sidekick. But cross her and prepare to pay the price. The sweet young lady becomes a merciless force of destruction, leaving bodies, utterly broken by her signature submission holds, in her righteous wake.

enrichment.description: In order for the princess of Magical Land, Punie Tanaka, to become queen she must become a transfer student in a Japanese high school. Due to her potential to become the next ruler, she has many enemies that wish to assassinate her. This proves difficult to them because Punie is both skilled at martial arts and possesses magic powers which she uses to quickly defeat her enemies.

527.name: DRAMAtical Murder (OVA)
527.japanese: ドラマティカルマーダー OVA
527.summary: Aoba wakes up in a strange dimension where he finds a duplicate of himself sitting before him. As the duplicate tells him that he brought this on himself, visions of his drastically changed friends appear one after another. Could this be a dream, an illusion, or something else...?

enrichment.description: Aoba lives on Midorijima, a small island to the southwest of the main islands of Japan. He lives with his grandmother Tae while working part time at a junk shop. The popular pastimes on the island are the ongoing turf war called "Libstease" and an online game set in the virtual world of "Rhyme." Aoba isn't involved in either, preferring to live peacefully, until one day he is forced into a Rhyme battle.

530.name: [Dub] Terror in Resonance
530.summary: In an alternate present day, Tokyo is rocked by a terrorist attack, with the only hint to the identity of the culprit a strange video uploaded to the Internet. Baffled by this cryptic clue, the police search for the criminal mastermind responsible for this tragedy, all while two mysterious children masterfully carry out their heinous plan. The pair combines to form “Sphinx”, a clandestine entity determined to wake the people from their slumber - and pull the trigger on this world.

enrichment.description: In an alternate version of the present, Tokyo has been decimated by a shocking terrorist attack, and the only hint to the identity of the culprit is a bizarre video uploaded to the internet. The police, baffled by this cryptic clue, are powerless to stop the paranoia spreading across the population. While the world searches for a criminal mastermind to blame for this tragedy, two mysterious children - children who shouldn't even exist - masterfully carry out their heinous plan. Cursed to walk through this world with the names Nine and Twelve, the two combine to form "Sphinx," a clandestine entity determine to wake the people from their slumber - and pull the trigger on this world.

529.name: [Dub] Gonna be the Twin-Tail!!
529.japanese: 俺、ツインテールになります(Dub)
529.summary: "To protect Earth, I'll become a twin tail!" Soji Mitsuka is an ordinary high school student with an obsessive love for twin tails. One day, a mysterious beautiful girl named Twoearle, who claims to have come from another world, appears before him. At the same time, monsters appear in the town where Soji lives! "All the twin tails in the world shall be ours!" The monsters are beings from another world who feed on people's emotional energy, known as "Attribute Strengths". Entrusted by Twoearle with the Tail Gear—an imaginary armor activated by the powerful Twin Tail Attribute—Soji transforms into the twin-tailed warrior girl, Tailred! From this day on, the insane battle between Tailred and the perverts begins!

enrichment.description: Souji Mitsuka is a first-year high school student who is obsessed with twin-tails. One day, a beautiful girl from a parallel world named Twoearle,  suddenly appeared in front of him and gave him the power to transform into the twin-tailed warrior Tail Red. With the Ultimegil organization attacking the planet, Souji now must fight in order to protect the peace on Earth.

531.name: [Dub] Mononoke
531.summary: In feudal Japan, evil spirits known as mononoke plague both households and the countryside, leaving a trail of fear in their wake. One mysterious person has the power to slay the mononoke where they stand; he is known only as the Medicine Seller, and he vanquishes the spirits using the power of his Exorcism Sword. However, in order to draw his sword he must first understand the Form, Truth and Reason of the mononoke. Armed with a sharp wit and keen intellect, the Medicine Seller wanders from place to place, striking down the evil spirits in his wake.

enrichment.description: The Medicine Seller is a deadly and mysterious master of the occult who travels across feudal Japan in search of malevolent spirits called mononoke to slay. When he locates one of these spirits, he cannot simply kill it; he must first learn its Form, its Truth, and its Reason in order to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword and fight against it. He must begin his strange exorcisms with intense psychological analysis and careful investigative work—an extremely dangerous step, as he must first confront and learn about the mononoke before he even has the means to defeat it.

544.name: MAGICAL GIRL RAISING PROJECT restart
544.summary: Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality. It was supposed to be a safe training exercise designed to improve their magical abilities. But instead, it marks the beginning of a carefully orchestrated nightmare - a forbidden trial. A new Magical Girl Raising Project has begun.

enrichment.description: Once again, sixteen Magical Girls have been assembled for a high-stakes challenge. Every three days, their Magical Phone pulls them into an RPG-like simulation where they have to work together to fight enemies, solve puzzles, and earn Magical Candy to advance. A staggering ten billion yen reward awaits them at the end—but only for the players who land the finishing blow. With such a tantalizing prize on the line, it's only a matter of time before the girls turn on each other—and if their hit points drop to zero, a game over will be the least of their worries...

538.name: My Girlfriend's Friend
538.summary: My first cute girlfriend ever. But her friend who's curvier than my girlfriend started seducing me… What would you do if your girlfriend's friend made a move on you like this? A captivating tale of forbidden love by Jura, the overwhelmingly popular manga artist on Young Magazine Web, now adapted into a TV anime.

enrichment.description: For the first time in my life, I have a girlfriend. But her friend tempts me with a body that's so seductive... What would you do if your girlfriend's friend came on to you like this?

536.name: [Dub]The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring
536.romaji: Hitozukiai ga nigate na miboujin no yukionna-san to noroi no yubiwa
536.summary: It's the modern world, where humans, yokai, and various other races coexist... One day, Satoru—who works as the apartment manager—ends up angering his secret crush, Mifuyu, a snow woman who lives in the same building. Eager to make amends, he uses a mysterious ring that is said to help in communicating with yokai. However, he finds himself hotly pursued by Mifuyu, who has suddenly become extremely forward. A socially aloof widowed snow woman and a young adult male who wants to support her. What awaits them at the end of their repeated physical encounters, fueled by the ring's power…?

enrichment.description: Satoru Takahashi, a young man who inherits his late father's apartment complex in a modern world where humans and yokai (supernatural creatures) coexist.

534.name: [Dub]Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
534.romaji: Mausukasoru de genjitsu wo sousadekiruyouninattanode, onnanoko wo ippai kurikku shimasu
534.summary: What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor? One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen. Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off... Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away... Here's Japan's (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!

528.name: Nyarko-san Another Crawling Chaos W
528.japanese: はいよれ！ニャル子さんW
528.summary: At the home of high school student Mahiro Yasaka, Nyarko the Cthulu Mythos evil deity "The Crawling Chaos" Nyarlathotep, Kuuko, the "Living Flame" Cthuga, and Hasuta, the "Indescribable One" Hasturian, continued to live as boarders. Having come to protect Earth from the evil deities, they spend their days living it up—fully immersing themselves in Earth's entertainment, making a move on Mahiro (with whom they'd fallen in love at first sight), and battling the evil deities threatening Earth's peace—all while Mahiro's peaceful daily life slips further and further away. Amidst all this, Kuune, Kuuko's cousin, shows up at the Yasaka household with news of a blind date for Kuuko— Far from taking one step forward and one step back, Nyarko and Mahiro's relationship has been stuck in a rut—will there finally be some progress?! With Kuuko and Hasuta getting in on the action, and Kuune, Tamao, and even the unexpected Shantak-kun joining the fray, will this romantic comedy descend into even greater chaos?! With a double dose of this frenetic, high-energy, chaotic comedy, the sanity level crisis is far from over!

enrichment.description: Mahiro Yasaka is just an ordinary high school student, until one day he is suddenly attacked by a dangerous monster. Just when everything seems to be lost, he is saved by a strange girl named Nyaruko, who claims to be the shape-shifting deity Nyarlathotep from horror author H. P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos.

542.name: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
542.summary: He has excellent grades in Japanese but is barely passing science and math! Ume Mizunoe, a literary young man, joins the student council to earn credit at Fujinari Academy. But in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet secretly perverted student council president, the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, a cheeky yet adorable boy, and the admin who's like a small, abandoned cat. The student council is full of quirky characters, and some busy and lively days are about to start!

enrichment.description: In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life story that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

520.name: Inuyashiki
520.summary: Ichiro Inuyashiki was a boring office worker living a life shunned by his family and coworkers. One night, a UFO crashed into him, and his body was rebuilt into a powerful robot. A high school student named Hiro Shishigami was also involved in the same accident, and he begins to use his new powers to enable his darkest impulses. Is man's true nature good or evil?

enrichment.description: Aliens replace middle-aged Inuyashiki's body with a combat robot. He uses it to fight high schooler Shishigami, who's using the same power selfishly.

532.name: Persona4 the ANIMATION
532.summary: "Hey, have you heard of the Midnight Channel?" Due to family circumstances, Yu Narukami moves from the city to the rural town of Inaba, where his uncle lives. A quiet townscape, a fading shopping district, and a large shopping mall where local youths gather...

enrichment.description: When Yu Narukami moves to the rural country town of Inaba to live with his uncle while his parents are away on business, he's expecting a lot more peace and quiet than he's been used to in the big city. Instead, the peace has been shattered as a rash of mysterious murders and kidnappings sweep the countryside. With the police stymied, Yu finds himself joining with a group of seven other teenagers in a desperate bid to solve the mystery. A mystery that is somehow connected to both the local weather patterns and a strange TV world which Yu, his friends and the enigmatic killer can all enter.

517.name: [Dub] Thermae Romae
517.summary: Lucius is a public bathhouse architect in ancient Rome who is serious about his work, nearly to a fault, but loses his job after refusing to change with the times. At the invitation of a friend, the depressed Roman stops by a bathhouse, where he’s suddenly catapulted through time and space to a public bath in modern-day Japan. Lucius is shocked by the bath culture of the “flat-faced tribe” (Japanese), but upon returning to ancient Rome, he causes a great stir by employing their ideas. The architect becomes quite good at time-traveling back and forth, and before long, achieves fame in Rome as a bathhouse engineer, but…

enrichment.description: The story is a comedy about Lucius, an architect of public bath houses in ancient Rome, who time-travels to various modern-day baths in Japan. The author explores the two cultures in the world "that have loved baths the most: the Japanese and the Romans."

519.name: [Dub] Harem Camp!
519.summary: Why don't we sleep together tonight? Four girls in a tent way too small for five people... Kensuke thought it would only be a one-night harem camp... so what are the girls doing at his work place?! This is the beginning of a daily life that promises to be spicy!

enrichment.description: The story follows teacher and veteran solo camper Kensuke, who forms a camping group with four girls.
enrichment.anilist_description:
Kensuke was enjoying some solo camping when he suddenly has to share his tent with three girls and their boyfriend... or not?
(Source: Coolmic)

Note: The complete edition with explicit scenes was distributed web via Comic Festa Anime Zone. The censored version was broadcasted on Tokyo MX and BS11.

526.name: [Dub] KAMUI ---He's behind you
526.japanese: うしろの正面カムイさん（OA）(Dub)
526.summary: This exorcism is OMFFFFFFFFF!!!! Shizuka is a self-proclaimed ordinary high school girl who "only" sees ghosts. Using her unique ability to attract spirits, she works as an assistant to the famous psychic, Kamui. Though Kamui boasts overwhelming spiritual power, his exorcism methods are unprecedented...?! Will Shizuka, tossed about by supernatural disturbances, ever find peace? The curtain rises on "supreme" exorcism!! OMFFFFFFFFFG ALMIGHTY!!

enrichment.description: Shizuka is a normal high school girl with the ability to see ghosts. Due to her peculiar tendency to attract ghosts, she works as an assistant to Kamui, a famous psychic. Kamui takes pride in his top-notch psychic abilities, but the way he exorcises ghosts is rather unusual!

506.name: YURU YURI San☆Hi!
506.summary: The Amusement Club, a club run by Akari Akaza, Kyoko Toshino, Yui Funami, and Chinatsu Yoshikawa. The Student Council, which has set its sights on them keeps meddling in their affairs, or so it seems. The laid-back story brimming with love is back! Guaranteed to give you the energy to face tomorrow with a smile :)

enrichment.description:
On her first day attending the all-girls Nanamori Middle School in Takaoka, Toyama Akaza Akari oversleeps, to be awakened by her one-year-senior childhood friends: the level-headed Funami Yui and the often self-centered Toshinou Kyouko. Planning on exciting club activities at school, Akari joins the club her older friends have set up. But as it turns out Kyouko and Yui simply took over the former room of the now defunct tea ceremony club for their own Amusement Club. In regard to what the club does, Kyouko explains: "We just hang out and do whatever we want!" This is not exactly what the helpful and energetic Akari had hoped for. Surprisingly a few days later Yoshikawa Chinatsu joins the club even though she mistook it for the former tea ceremony club.

And so the four fun-loving girls could enjoy spending their spare time at the club were it not for the student council, in person of vice president Sugiura Ayano, who does her very best to shut down this unauthorized club.

507.name: Galilei Donna
507.summary: The year is 2061. Global warming is a thing of the past, and the world is now shrouded in the harsh conditions of the early Ice Age. Hozuki, Kazuki, and Hazuki—descendants of Galileo Galilei living in Tuscany, Italy—are suddenly attacked by a mysterious organization and, to make matters worse, end up on the international wanted list. The organization’s objective is something known as the Galileo Treasure. Although the three sisters have absolutely no idea what this is, they must join forces to overcome this crisis! …However, with their personalities so vastly different, getting them to work as a team is an incredibly difficult feat. What is the Tesoro? What is this organization? And what will become of the three sisters…? A battle-action adventure featuring three very unique young women!

enrichment.description: Hozuki, Hazaki, and Kazaki Ferrari, three descendents of Galileo, live in Tuscany. A mysterious organization is searching for the "Galilei Donna," and put out an international arrest warrant for the three sisters. The sisters must put aside their differences to join forces in fighting the organization and learning their true destiny.

505.name: [Dub] Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
505.summary: Now I can see how much my crush likes me──… ──I lack the courage to confess to my childhood friend, Marika. One day, I make a strong wish upon a shooting star: To read someone's feelings like in a dating sim. The very next day, much to my surprise, that wish came true…?! Lovemeters now appear over the girls in my class. Confused by this surreal sight, I check Marika's, only to find her meter's plummeted to the rotten depths of hell...?! Marika, if you hate me, then why were you always so kind...? What are Marika's hidden true feelings? Does she really hate me, or...?!

503.name: Typhoon Noruda
503.summary: It was back when I couldn't be honest about anything. The tale of one night with a mysterious girl who taught us what was really important. The setting is a small middle school on a remote island. Azuma has been playing baseball since early boyhood, but suddenly quits. When Azuma won’t give a reason, his best friend, Saijo, can’t hide his irritation. The two of them gradually grow apart. In the middle of all this, the students are confined to the school when the typhoon of a lifetime hits. After the power goes out, a gust of wind breaks windows, exposing the school to nature’s fury. Meanwhile, Azuma encounters a mysterious girl who falls unconscious after being struck by lightning. The girl’s name is Noruda. She claims that at dawn, Earth will be swallowed up by a pillar connecting “the earth vortex” to “the sky vortex” and then reassembled. Azuma is disturbed by Noruda’s preposterous story, but is also drawn to her mysterious aura, and resolves to help her. Azuma tells Saijo about Noruda and asks for his help. But Saijo thought Azuma was finally about to have a confidential talk about baseball, so he won’t so much as listen to his former best friend. Azuma struggles to do whatever he can alone, but is helpless when Noruda is swept up by a powerful force. He hurries after her, but Saijo stops him. Azuma couldn’t be open with Saijo and Saijo couldn’t have faith in Azuma, but the two have it out at last. Afterwards, they team up, making a mad dash to save Noruda (and save the world).

enrichment.description: As an unexpected typhoon bears down on a small tropical island, a group of students trapped at school find themselves forced to put aside their personal issues and work together. Not only to save themselves, but possibly the lives of everyone on the planet!

498.name: [Dub] C
498.summary: The world of Kimimaro Yoga is no different than ordinary Japan, 2011.  An economics major but with no ambisions, he hopes for nothing more than to live a mediocre life. But his world changes one day when a shady man by the name of Masakaki turns up with a proposal for Yoga on behalf of the Bank of Midas-- “This bank will lend funds using your future abilities as collateral.  Will you use your present abilities to invest it?”　Despite the fear of loosing, Yoga finds himself led by Masakaki to... the Financial District.  Once he is enlisted as an “Entrepeneur”, Yoga realizes that he is an executive Player, along with his Asset Mashu, and they must now battle through trading and invest in order to keep afloat in the Game, not to loose their entire future!

enrichment.description: A high school student named Yachi Haruaki receives a mysterious, super-heavy black cube from his father overseas. That night, Haruaki wakes up to a suspicious noise in the kitchen, and he discovers a fully naked female thief of rice crackers. The girl, Fear, is the first of several surprises that Haruaki receives.

502.name: [Dub] Rampo Kitan Club

The two boys join Nitta East Middle School's baseball team, but are caught up in friction among their teammates and find themselves at the mercy of their teacher's adult problems. Occasionally clashing with each other, the pitcher and catcher duo grow together as a 'battery'.

There, he meets a new classmate Go Nagakura, a catcher who is able to get Takumi's most powerful pitches. Takumi and Go both join the school's baseball team where they develop a firm friendship and grow as individuals through their battery.

485.summary: It's an April shower morning. Cherry blossoms that have begun to fall are pelted by the rain and float in puddles. Students carrying colorful umbrellas pass through the high school gates. In front of the shoe lockers, Yua greets Ren, who is standing there in her wet tights. Just as Ren dejectedly turns around, Homi, who is even more soaked, bounces over and joins in the conversation. The lighthearted conversation among these three high school girls heralds the arrival of the new semester in the classroom. The seasons change as the girls' irreplaceable moments fly by…

enrichment.description: Inspired by mangaka Yomu’s fascination with women’s legwear presented in his art book “Yomu Tights”, “Miru Tights” takes us into a world of sheer tights and beautiful women’s legs. The bright Homi Moemi, the serious and ambitious Ren Aikawa, and the cheerful, albeit somewhat naïve Yua Nakabeni have been friends for a long time and of course, their tights are part of their everyday attire! While Homi likes to jump into the biggest puddles she can find on rainy days, and Yua devotes herself completely to cosplay – much to the delight of her numerous followers on Twitter – Ren is more serious and works at a small café in her free time.

486.name: Yuru Yuri Season 2
486.summary: A group of four who have illegally occupied the former tea ceremony clubroom continue to carry out the activities of the Amusement Club (though there aren't really any specific activities to speak of). The Student Council, which has set its sights on them keeps meddling in their affairs, or so it seems. A laid-back story brimming with love that's guaranteed to give you the energy to face tomorrow with a smile.

enrichment.description:
On her first day attending the all-girls Nanamori Middle School in Takaoka, Toyama Akaza Akari oversleeps, to be awakened by her one-year-senior childhood friends: the level-headed Funami Yui and the often self-centered Toshinou Kyouko. Planning on exciting club activities at school, Akari joins the club her older friends have set up. But as it turns out Kyouko and Yui simply took over the former room of the now defunct tea ceremony club for their own Amusement Club. In regard to what the club does, Kyouko explains: "We just hang out and do whatever we want!" This is not exactly what the helpful and energetic Akari had hoped for. Surprisingly a few days later Yoshikawa Chinatsu joins the club even though she mistook it for the former tea ceremony club.

And so the four fun-loving girls could enjoy spending their spare time at the club were it not for the student council, in person of vice president Sugiura Ayano, who does her very best to shut down this unauthorized club.

484.name: [Dub] What She Fell on Was the Tip of My...
484.summary: The best thing living in this old apartment is that there is a beautiful landlady and a girl living upstairs of me. One day the ceiling comes falling down onto me with the girl and...!? A miracle happening which leads to a life living with two girls. How will this love triangle settle??

enrichment.description:
Sousuke Aikawa is a part-time worker who lives in a rundown apartment building where his only consolation is that the landlord is a beautiful woman and the girl who lives above him is cute.

One day though, the ceiling above him creaks and... Bang! In from the second floor, directly above him, the cute girl comes crashing down on him…!?

In an erotic encounter that can only be classified as a miracle, hearts and bodies are connected by chance. Then for some reason, he starts to live with both of these beautiful women!? Under this one roof, just what exactly will become of this crowded love triangle...!?
enrichment.anilist_description: Sousuke is a part timer living in an old, rusty apartment. It's not a bad place to live though, with a cute landlady Yuki who takes care of the place. Also, another cute girl Sunao living upstairs is great too. One day when Sousuke was bashing off, the ceiling came falling down with Sunao and she lands on his...(Source: Coolmic, edited)

484.japanese: じょしおちっ！～2階から女の子が…降ってきた！？～(OA)(Dub)

445.japanese: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない。
445.summary: Kyousuke brings Kirino home from America where she attended a special track & field camp. Surrounded by her friends, Kirino gradually gets her life back to normal. In stark contrast to her friends is Kyousuke, who is unhappy with Kirino's attitude towards him. She has been ignoring him since she came home, as if their relationship had gone back to how it had been a year earlier. But then Kirino does something for Kyousuke...

enrichment.description: Oreimo follows the daily life of an ordinary high school boy named Kyousuke Kousaka. Kyousuke’s younger sister Kirino is a pretty fashion model, but also hides a dark secret of being an otaku of adult games. Kyousuke is the only person to whom Kirino reveals her hidden obsession and other issues.

483.name: Hanayamata
483.summary: By all appearances, she is normal. Her style, her face, her looks – all normal. The name of this 14-year-old next-door girl is Naru Sekiya. She’d always dreamed of being heroine in some sort of fairy tale, waiting for someone to whisk her away from this world – but even now, as a second-grader in middle school, her days remain nothing but normal. But one night, Naru encounters a young, blonde-haired girl dancing in traditional Japanese clothing under the light of the moon. “Would you like to do yosakoi with me?” the girl asks. [referencing a type of Japanese dancing dating back hundreds of years.] Though initially hesitant at this sudden turn of events, Naru is drawn by this foreign girl, named Hana, and takes her first steps into the alien world that is yosakoi. Though still children, they are on the cups of adulthood… The curtain is about to rise on the tale of these young girls in their prime of bloom!

enrichment.description: Naru is a high school girl who is average in every way. She loves fairy tale heroines, though she’s never had the courage to escape her ordinary life. One day, she sees Hannah, a transfer student, dancing in the moonlit and becomes inspired to learn Yosakoi dancing.

481.summary: Aoba, who lives a pretty ordinary life, works at the junk shop "Mediocrity." The manager asks him to make a delivery one day, but he finds out that there's nothing at the address he was supposed to deliver it to. It was then that Aoba was consumed by light and he was within a mysterious world.

enrichment.description: Aoba lives on Midorijima, a small island to the southwest of the main islands of Japan. He lives with his grandmother Tae while working part time at a junk shop. The popular pastimes on the island are the ongoing turf war called "Libstease" and an online game set in the virtual world of "Rhyme." Aoba isn't involved in either, preferring to live peacefully, until one day he is forced into a Rhyme battle.

472.name: Bombshells from the Sky
472.summary: Nice guy Kio's normal life gets turned upside down when he meets a friendly, sexy cat-alien named Eris! She's on a peaceful mission - and she's ready to play! Things get even friskier when her fellow felines set up base in Kio's house!

Things get even friskier when her fellow felines set up base in Kio’s house. It’s not all fun and games, though. Danger is afoot, thanks to several secret agencies and enemy dog-aliens on Eris’s tail.

471.name: Nyarko-san Another Crawling Chaos
471.japanese: はいよれ！ニャル子さん
471.summary: A beautiful girl with silver hair and blue eyes appears before high school student Mahiro Yasaka, along with an utterly absurd greeting. She introduces herself as a Nyarlathotep, the evil deity of the Cthulu Mythos known as the Crawling Chaos—or Nyarko for short. Nyarko, an alien who came to protect Mahiro and who, on top of that, fell in love with him at first sight, moves in with him and even transfers into his class, closing in on him with overwhelming intensity. Meanwhile, other evil deities keep arriving on Earth, one after another, targeting Mahiro. With the addition of Kuuko, the "Living Flame" Cthuga, and Hasuta, the "Indescribable One" Hasturian, Mahiro's daily life is swallowed up by a vortex of chaos—. What is the truth behind these epic events unfolding on a cosmic scale? Will Mahiro ever be able to live in peace?! A high-octane, chaotic comedy crawling toward you with the catchphrase, "Uu! Nyaa!"

enrichment.description: Mahiro Yasaka is just an ordinary high school student, until one day he is suddenly attacked by a dangerous monster. Just when everything seems to be lost, he is saved by a strange girl named Nyaruko, who claims to be the shape-shifting deity Nyarlathotep from horror author H. P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos.

470.name: Perfect Addiction
470.japanese: パーフェクトアディクション
470.summary: Akihito, a college student with a penchant for pretty faces and a penchant for womanizing, finds Sae's beautiful face and aloof attitude utterly irritating. At a group date, he discovers that the girl he was targeting was only interested in Sae, pushing his frustration to its peak. Just then, Akihito stumbles upon Sae arguing with a man in a hotel district. Seeing Sae so vulnerable, a stark contrast to his usual self, Akihito is provoked and forcefully pushes him down. However, his unexpected reaction causes him to lose control...?!

466.name: LEVEL E
466.summary: Do you love a good prank? Does your scene of humor border on sadistic? Then you’ll love Level e, a hilariously twisted new series from the creator of Yu Yu Hakusho and Hunter × Hunter that’s unlike anything you’ve ever seen! This extraterrestrial adventure follows the alien genius, Prince Baka as he turns life on earth into his own personal laugh track, The Prince has the biggest brain in the galaxy, and he’s also a sadistic prankster who loves to make humans squirm. Anime fans will fall hard for this nostalgic, “undeniably clever” series that spoofs the television shows, video games, and superheroes they loved as kids. You’ll laugh, you’ll cry, you’ll remember that thing you did that was super mean-but also super hilarious.(Dont’t worry, you wont’t get grounded.) So yeah, Levele. The alien invasion has begun. Prepare to die-laughing.

Baka, the prince of the planet Dogra, crash lands on Earth and loses his memory. He forcibly moves in with Yukitaka Tsutsui, a first year high school student who had just moved out on his own. The normal life he once knew is quickly pulled away as he becomes the target of the prince's torment.

465.name: Love Hina
465.summary: Fifteen years ago, Keitaro Urashima met a girl and promised her to enter Tokyo University together. To keep this promise, he is now preparing for another entrance exam, although he has already failed twice. One day, when he visits his grandmother's Japanese-style inn, he comes up with a brilliant idea to live and get a part-time job here. But this inn has been changed to girls' dormitory "Hinata-sou". When he runs across a girl at an open-air hot spring, he is mistaken as a molester...

About a decade later, Keitaro has become an artist and a daydreamer, having ranked 27th from the last in the national practice exam. When his grandmother leaves the all-girls dormitory, he becomes the residential manager and soon meets up with two Todai applicants who may have been that sweetheart, since he`s forgotten her name. Then there the other tenants like young Shinobu who was in despair until Keitaro helped her, Motoko the swordsmaster who sees men as evil distractions, Su Kaolo the genius child inventor and the sneaky Kitsune.

462.name: Chainsmoker Cat
462.summary: In a world where humans and beasties coexist, lived Yani Neko, a beastie who smokes and leads a slacker's life. No money! No life skills! A total good-for-nothing! Tossed her manners and morals in the trash along with her cigarette butts. She reeks of smoke, is filthy, lazy, and a total scumbag. Smoking, exhaling, nyattering, and burning out. Still, she's living a pretty fulfilling life in her own way. Pretty gross, yet quite heartwarming, the manga that's gone viral on social media takes up the challenge of becoming an anime adaptation! Sorry if it doesn't make it to air, nya! Please go easy on these somehow lovable, sleazy felines as you watch their nicotine-soaked daily lives unfold.

420.name: The Perfect Insider
420.summary: Magata Shiki is a genius programmer who has lived in complete isolation at a research facility on a remote island since childhood. Saikawa Sohei, an associate professor at Nagono University, and his student, Nishinosono Moe, visit the facility hoping to meet Shiki in person, only to encounter a horrific incident. What they witnessed was a corpse—dressed in a wedding gown with all four limbs severed—emerging from Shiki's room, a place no one was supposed to be able to enter or leave. And so, Saikawa and Moe take on the mysterious locked-room murder.

enrichment.description: Souhei Saikawa is a college professor who is obsessed with genius Shiki Magata’s work. He, Moe Nishinosono, and a group of his other students plan a retreat to the remote island where Magata currently resides, which may put them in danger’s way...

448.name: You're Being Summoned, Azazel-san
448.japanese: よんでますよ、アザゼルさん。
448.summary: Rinko Sakuma is a college student working at the Akutabe Detective Agency. Her employer, Akutabe, recognized her potential and hired her as an assistant. As she handles cases alongside him, she comes to discover Akutabe's secret identity as the Demon Detective. One day, after receiving a request from a wife who wanted to break up her husband and his mistress, Akutabe uses a grimoire to summon an incredibly vulgar demon named Azazel from the demon realm. Azazel sets out to handle the case in exchange for a human sacrifice, but things take an unexpected turn… It's another one of Sakuma's chaotic days with these quirky demons—who seem useful but very often aren't...

His new part-time employee Sakuma, a young college girl, doesn't get to spend too much time exploring the finer points of controlling demons before Akutabe forces her into a demonic contract with Azazel. Azazel is lazy, lustful, and depraved... Everything you'd expect a demon to be. Sakuma needs to keep Azazel on a tight leash, but to do that, she may have to dabble in a little depravity herself.

Despite his misgivings, the deeper he's drawn into the world of the Five Leaves, the more he finds himself fascinated by these devious, mysterious outlaws.

Beautiful, brainy, and an indispensable office worker for a robotics manufacturer, Akane's admired at work...because her colleagues can't see her at home. Privately, Akane's a hot mess with an apartment that looks more like a landfill than a living space. Good thing she drunkenly ordered a new android named Nadeshiko to help her clean up! 433.name: My New Boss is Goofy
433.summary: Currently serialized in Manga Cross and a hit comic that has sold over 500,000 copies, comes the long-awaited TV anime adaptation of this soul-soothing workplace comedy! After his power-harassing boss broke his spirit and his health, Momose leaves his job to work at a new job in sales at an advertising agency. However, on the very first day of his new job, Momose is unable to move due to a stomachache caused by his past traumas. "What should I do if my new boss also abuses his power?" In the meantime, his new boss Shirosaki is out with him to see the clients. Just what exactly is Shirosaki going to do…?! This boss' unexpectedly "goofy" nature will surely heal anyone!!

enrichment.description: Forced to change jobs after being bullied by his boss, office worker Momose worries his new boss will be the same. But Shirosaki is totally easygoing!

415.name: One: Kagayaku Kisetsu e
415.summary: The 1998 PC game that captured fans' hearts and still holds them captive, ONE: Toward the Shining Season, is now available on OVA! Following the death of his sister, Kouhei Orihara embarks on a journey to the "World of Eternity." As time passes and he is gradually forgotten by those around him, he takes action to find someone who will keep his existence alive.

430.name: Eromanga Sensei
430.summary: Masamune Izumi is a high school student who writes light novels. Sagiri Izumi is a shut-in who never leaves her room. A year ago, she became Masamune’s little sister. But one day, Masamune discovers a shocking twist— The artist "Eromanga Sensei," who has been drawing illustrations for his novels, is none other than his little sister Sagiri! His cute little shut-in of a sister, who has been living under his roof, is using an obscene pen name and draws lewd illustrations?! This slapstick comedy about a light-novel author big brother and his little sister the illustrator brings a cast of charming characters surpassing even that of “Oreimo!”

enrichment.description: Masamune Izumi is a high school student who writes light novels. Sagiri Izumi is an antisocial girl who never leaves her room. A year ago, she became Masamune's stepsister. But one day, Masamune discovers a terrifying revelation: the artist “Eromanga-sensei,” who illustrates his novels, is none other than his sister Sagiri! His antisocial little sister, who lives under the same roof as him, uses a spicy pseudonym and draws obscenities?!

418.name: Glass Maiden
418.japanese: クリスタル ブレイズ
418.summary: In a dystopian future, in a corner of Asia lies Lags Town, a symbol of the dark side of false prosperity. Here in this city unfolds a hard-boiled buddy story filled with spectacular gunfights! "Glass Maiden" is a stylish, authentic animated series, featuring meticulously detailed props and gadgets throughout the whole story.

enrichment.description: In Rags Town, a city full of scum,  a carefree detective named Shun is living in this city, doing what he pleases. But one day he meets a beautiful girl who's lost her memory, and he tries to solve her mystery without knowing that this would change his life and make him face a powerful enemy.

432.name: Oreimo
432.japanese: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない
432.summary: For the past seven years, Kyousuke's relationship with his younger sister Kirino has been nothing but cold. It has come to a point where the siblings only exchange greetings with each other. But one day, Kyousuke finds a moe anime DVD lying in the entrance hall of his house. As his interest piqued, Kyousuke looks for the owner, only to discover it belongs to his very own sister Kirino. Shocked as Kyousuke was, this was just the beginning to the surprises that lie ahead…

enrichment.description: Oreimo follows the daily life of an ordinary high school boy named Kyousuke Kousaka. Kyousuke’s younger sister Kirino is a pretty fashion model, but also hides a dark secret of being an otaku of adult games. Kyousuke is the only person to whom Kirino reveals her hidden obsession and other issues.

417.name: Welcome to Irabu's Office
417.summary: The psychiatric ward at Irabu General Hospital is where many patients with different problems visit: a trapeze artist suffering from insomnia after suddenly failing his jumps, a yakuza who is afraid of sharp objects, and a businessman who has a 24-hour erection, and so on. There, they receive treatment from Dr. Ichiro Irabu, the child-like son of the hospital director. Assisting him is the sullen-faced sexy nurse Mayumi. With his mysterious injections and advice that makes no sense, Dr. Irabu throws his patients into confusion. However, through their encounters with Dr. Irabu and his seemingly outrageous treatments, the patients begin to reflect on themselves and gradually find peace of mind.

enrichment.description: Welcome to Irabu's Office, where you may be greeted by a man in a bear mask, holding a giant needle, who’s ready to cure your ills. Get to know the eccentric Dr. Ichirou Irabu who has a fetish for injections, and a rather strange methodology. Despite his weird approach, Dr. Irabu (who changes his appearance more than Madonna), does succeed in helping each of his patients... eventually.

429.name: Doukyusei -Classmates-
429.summary: Licht Sajo is an honor student who got perfect scores in every subject on his high school entrance exam. Hikaru Kusakabe plays guitar in his band that performs at live events and is popular among the girls. These boys would have never crossed paths. But one day Hikaru offers to help Licht prepare for their upcoming chorus festival and the two begin to talk. As the two meet after school, they feel one another's sound, listen to each other's voice, and begin to harmonize as their hearts beat together. It starts out slow but soon their feelings for one another grow and in just one moment they both realize that it is love. Hikaru's emotions are frivolous, pure and direct causing Licht to hesitate at first, but he gradually opens his heart. The boys are learning about each other as they also learn about themselves and support one another during this difficult time typical to youth. As the time to start thinking about their futures approaches, what do these young men find as they try to move forward...

enrichment.description: Rihito Sajo, an honor student with a perfect score on the entrance exam and Hikaru Kusakabe, in a band and popular among girls, would have never crossed paths. Until one day they started talking at the practice for their school’s upcoming chorus festival. After school, the two meet regularly, as Hikaru helps Rihito to improve his singing skills. While they listen to each other’s voice and harmonize, their hearts start to beat together.

431.name: I Want You To Show Me Your Panties With a Disgusted Face Returns
431.romaji: Iyanakao sarenagara opantsu misete moraitai R
431.japanese: 嫌な顔されながらおパンツ見せてもらいたいR
431.summary: I want to see a girl show her panties—a desire men have had since time immemorial. But just seeing them isn't enough. That moment of guilty pleasure, when she shows them to you with a look of disgust…! A new story interwined by seven girls is about to begin... The worst and greatest showtime is back! The most diverse cast of characters in the series' history is here to make your dreams come true. Everyone has a secret (ideal) tucked away...

enrichment.description: A project where a number of women in different costumes show their panties while they make a disgusted face.

410.name: Guardian Hearts-Power UP!
410.summary: One day, a girl appears out of the blue—turns out she's a super clumsy heroine, and an alien to boot! From then on, one troublesome alien beauty after another start showing up... Original work by Sae Amatsu! A sci-fi romantic comedy!

enrichment.description: Maya, Kurusu, and Chelsea hit it off really well when trying to get revenge on Guardian Hearts for making them suffer. Maya and company thought that Guardian Hearts usually appears when Kazuya is getting along with a girl. Not knowing that Guardian Hearts is actually Hina, they leave her alone with Kazuya in an attempt to lure out Guardian Hearts.

410.japanese: がぁ〜でぃあんHearts♡ぱわーあっぷ！

400.name: Hiiro no Kakera
400.summary: Tamaki Kasuga is invited to live with her grandmother when her parents transferred overseas. However, the real reason why Tamaki was called over to the village was to fulfill the ancestral duty of the the Tamayori Princess lineage: to seal the sword known as Onikirimaru. The young men known as the Five Guardians destined to protect the princess appear before Tamaki, and with their support, she awakens to her role as the Tamayori Princess.

enrichment.description: Believing she is to live with her grandmother because her parents are transferred abroad, Tamaki Kasuga travels to the town of Kifumura. There, she is told that she is actually to perform the role of sealing the sword Onikirimaru as the next 'Tamayori princess'. To protect her, she is also assigned young men from another family as guardians.

374.name: Mononoke
374.summary: In feudal Japan, evil spirits known as mononoke plague both households and the countryside, leaving a trail of fear in their wake. One mysterious person has the power to slay the mononoke where they stand; he is known only as the Medicine Seller, and he vanquishes the spirits using the power of his Exorcism Sword. However, in order to draw his sword he must first understand the Form, Truth and Reason of the mononoke. Armed with a sharp wit and keen intellect, the Medicine Seller wanders from place to place, striking down the evil spirits in his wake.

enrichment.description: The Medicine Seller is a deadly and mysterious master of the occult who travels across feudal Japan in search of malevolent spirits called mononoke to slay. When he locates one of these spirits, he cannot simply kill it; he must first learn its Form, its Truth, and its Reason in order to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword and fight against it. He must begin his strange exorcisms with intense psychological analysis and careful investigative work—an extremely dangerous step, as he must first confront and learn about the mononoke before he even has the means to defeat it.

416.name: Ichijyoma Mankitsu Gurashi!
416.japanese: 一畳間まんきつ暮らし！
416.summary: Meiko Morita is chosen to transfer into an elite all-girls academy and moves to Tokyo to live in the student dormitory. To her surprise, the dorm also operates as a manga cafe - and she finds herself working there alongside the other residents. This is the beginning of Meiko's new life in a tiny one-tatami room!

enrichment.description: Meiko Morita is chosen to transfer into an elite all-girls academy and moves to Tokyo to live in the student dormitory. To her surprise, the dorm also operates as a manga cafe - and she finds herself working there alongside the other residents. This is the beginning of Meiko's new life in a tiny one-tatami room!

395.name: My Lord and Me ~The Ambition Behind the Eyepatch~
395.japanese: 殿といっしょ ～眼帯の野望～
395.summary: The Sengoku period—a time of rival warlords. Battles, schemes, ambition… and gag comedy?! An era where the passions of various people collided. This story is a Sengoku period comedy featuring wildly eccentric lords like Masamune Date, the eccentric eyepatch-obsessed inventor, and the retainers who are at the mercy of them.

enrichment.description: Masamune, Nobunaga, and Kenshin are all completely out of their minds! Get ready to laugh your pants off with the Sengoku period gag manga "My Lord and Me"!! The hit comic depicting the everyday lives of warlords unlike their historical personas is now adapted into an anime!

373.name: The Great Passage
373.summary: Mitsuya Majime, a salesman who has trouble with speaking, and Masashi Nishioka, a man who looks like a lady-killer but who actually works in a dictionary editing department, meet by chance in the middle of the city. Veteran editor Araki is working on a project to publish a new dictionary called “The Daitokai (Great Passage)”, but with his retirement coming up he’s searching hard for a successor.  When he hears about Majime from Nishioka, he decides to try and hire him… “Weaving the words that connect the hearts of people” Words unheard.  Emotions that cannot be shared. This is the story of people who struggle to share with others what they truly mean to say.

enrichment.description: The publication of a new dictionary titled The Great Passage progresses. Mitsuya Majime, originally from publisher Genbu Shobo's sales department, has been recruited by Kouhei Araki, a veteran editor of the dictionary department who is looking to retire soon. The dictionary department is known internally as the "money-eating insect," but Mitsuya uses his perseverance and attachment to the words in order to become a great editor. Mitsuya, who has poor social skills, finds himself working with another man named Masashi Nishioka, who is able to express himself better.

412.name: Ingoku Danchi:Deviant's Apartment Complex
412.summary: Yoshida takes over as manager of an apartment complex on behalf of his father. Awaiting him there were the attacks of the housewives driven mad by the lewd outfit brand, "Libido Cloth." While being tossed about by the rampage of residents like Watanabe and Ichinose, the threat of Rank A housewife, Kanzaki, and the shadow of police obstructing the case further deepens the darkness within the complex. Armed with the countermeasure "Boltack Claw," Yoshida fights them, but lurking behind him was the grasp of an even greater despair: the "Banishing Exclusion Women's Society."

enrichment.description: Yoshida is a tiny, frail high school graduate who became an unwilling manager of an apartment complex when his father, the former manager, injured himself. Unbeknownst to him, this apartment complex houses quite a few women with very... unusual sexual preferences. This becomes a problem when a mysterious entity begins giving "Libido Cloth" to these women—skimpy outfits that give them superpowers and cause them to go on lewd rampages! Will Yoshida be able to stop them?

414.name: [Dub] Do You Like Big Girls?
414.summary: Sota was suddenly made dorm manager and coach of the Hokuei University Women's Volleyball Club as prompted by his older sister, Kaori. There, he had a fateful reunion with Ayano, his first love... In the girls' dorm! In the gym! In a hotel?! What awaited him were days of being bossed around by girls bigger than him! A Happy Harem Rom-Com of Size Differences♡ Born Huge on the Northern Plains!!

368.name: Terror in Resonance
368.summary: In an alternate present day, Tokyo is rocked by a terrorist attack, with the only hint to the identity of the culprit a strange video uploaded to the Internet. Baffled by this cryptic clue, the police search for the criminal mastermind responsible for this tragedy, all while two mysterious children masterfully carry out their heinous plan. The pair combines to form “Sphinx”, a clandestine entity determined to wake the people from their slumber - and pull the trigger on this world.

While the world searches for a criminal mastermind to blame for this tragedy, two mysterious children - children who shouldn't even exist - masterfully carry out their heinous plan. Cursed to walk through this world with the names Nine and Twelve, the two combine to form "Sphinx," a clandestine entity determine to wake the people from their slumber - and pull the trigger on this world.

364.name: Ristorante Paradiso
364.japanese: リストランテ・パラディーゾ
364.summary: Rome, Italy. As a child, Nicoletta was left in her grandmother's care when her mother remarried. Now grown up, she leaves the countryside determined to reveal the truth to her mother’s new husband—the owner of a restaurant—who has no idea his wife has a daughter. The ristorante she arrives at, "Casetta dell'Orso," is a slightly unusual place staffed entirely by charming gentlemen wearing　reading glasses—the cameriere Claudio, Luciano, and Vito; the sommelier Gigi; and the chefs, Furio and Teo. It is Rome’s miraculous paradiso, bustling daily with female patrons eager to meet these gentlemen, where even getting a reservation proves difficult. By chance, Nicoletta begins working at "Casetta dell'Orso", but soon found herself drawn to one of the gentlemen... At the ristorante Casetta dell'Orso in Rome, delicious food and charming gentlemen await. Gently weaving together the heartfelt connections between those who work there and those who visit, a story of elegant Italian gentlemen in spectacles begins.

enrichment.description: When she was a child, Nicoletta was taken in by her grandmother so that her mother could remarry. Now grown up, she leaves everything in the countryside behind to visit her mother and her mother's second husband, a ristorante owner. For everyone who works there, a tender connection to the hearts of each visitor is spun, and the curtain raises on a story about these first-rate Italian gentlemen in spectacles.

399.name: Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
399.summary: Now I can see how much my crush likes me──… ──I lack the courage to confess to my childhood friend, Marika. One day, I make a strong wish upon a shooting star: To read someone's feelings like in a dating sim. The very next day, much to my surprise, that wish came true…?! Lovemeters now appear over the girls in my class. Confused by this surreal sight, I check Marika's, only to find her meter's plummeted to the rotten depths of hell...?! Marika, if you hate me, then why were you always so kind...? What are Marika's hidden true feelings? Does she really hate me, or...?!

389.name: VANQUISHED QUEENS
389.japanese: ヴァンキッシュド・クイーンズ
389.summary: Depicting the complete defeat of the beautiful Queen's Blade's warriors, "Vanquished Queens" is finally getting an anime adaptation! What brutal trials await the beautiful warriors?! Let the groundbreaking tale of the beautiful warriors' shocking defeat begin!!

enrichment.description: Every few years, beautiful female warriors from across the land compete in the Queen's Blade Tournament to become the ruler of the land. It's a series that loves violence as much as it hates clothes and complicated plots.

386.name: Super Goddess Dangaiser 3
386.summary: Behind the scenes of a futuristic city built off the coast of former Okinawa, Neo Hong Kong, is a secret organization with its own biological network called Goma. The Four Heavenly Kings of Goma, DD the earth, Dine the wind, Sapphire the fire, and Pixis the water, are devising a plan to stop Dangaiser's return. He gets resurrected by the awakening of the three Eternal Mazaria, Cindy, Reika, and Hina. Neo Hong Kong erupts in flames in a fierce battle against Goma's assassin, Todorkood. However, Hina, who has just awakened, was yet to grasp the horror and meaning of this battle…

enrichment.description: 10,000 years ago, acting as judge, jury and executioner, Dangaizer sealed the fate of mankind by reducing it to ashes. Slowly, mankind rebuilt their civilization and once again stands at its peak. Hiding amongst the survivors of mankind, the evil organization of Goma lies in wait for the return of Dangaizer. This time, it’s a race to stop the awakening of the 3 that can pilot Dangaizer and subjugate the world to their rule. Will the 3rd pilot learn her true destiny and awaken in time, or will the world find a new destiny in the hands of Goma?

388.name: Voogie's Angels
388.summary: In the year 202 of the New Calendar, Earth has fallen into the hands of an unknown intelligent life form from space: SE, SPACE EMIGRANT. And now, five cyber girls, bearing a great mission and humanity's hope, spring into action. They are the Cyber Squadron Voogie's Angels!!

enrichment.description:
In the year 2020,​ Earth is conquered by a malevolent alien life form.​ The last remnants of humankind barely escape death by hiding in the oceans and creating underwater ."Aqua-bases.​"

One hundred years later,​ they are attempting to retake their world.​ The human survivors create a deadly strike force composed of one human and four,​ cybernetically enhanced,​ voluptuous young women: the motherly Midi,​ the spirited Voogie,​ the hard-hitting Rebecca,​ the innocent Merrybell,​ and the pensive Shiori.​

Specially trained and armed with the latest weaponry,​ they carry out guerrilla attacks against the alien invaders!

388.japanese: 電脳戦隊ヴギィ'ズ★エンジェル

387.name: Dragoon
387.summary: A fateful encounter foreshadowing a grand battle with the Dragoon!! A boy, not yet a hero, vows to fight for a girl's fragile smile...

enrichment.description: When the young swordsman, Sedon, finds the beautiful Miu unconscious and naked in the snow, he has no idea that she is the product of an evil experiment. Nor is he aware that ruthless soldiers have been ordered to track her down and bring her back. But soon he discovers just how important Miu is to an evil plan that involves treacherous royalty, bloodthirsty killers and a devastating power within May herself.

385.name: Variable Geo
385.summary: Yuka Takeuchi is the utmost powerful waitress! What does she keep fighting for?! Beautiful girls enter the martial arts tournament ‘V.G.’. Glory, honor, prize money… The winner takes it all, while the loser is destined to lose everything, even their dignity. However, something within them draws them to fight. What awaits the girls inside the ring... Despair or hope…? The fists respond to the soul's gong!!

enrichment.description:
The special of the day is Variable Geo-a brutal battle between waitresses who serve up generous portions of energy blasts and vicious side orders of murderous martial artistry.

For buffed beauties who make below-minimum wages, VG is the perfect way to make some fast cash. The victorious walk away with millions, and the defeated lose everything.

But this high-stakes sport has dark forces and dubious practices behind the fun and games. Lethal injections make steroids seem like vitamins. Instead of team prayer, there's demonic possession. Athletic sponsors are malevolent corporations with a more frightening agenda than increased market share. It's all just part of the game.

393.name: [Dub] Black Jack (The Complete OVA Series Dubbed)
393.summary: When mysterious medical ailments strike, the mysterious Black Jack is who to call - an unlicensed doctor who can solve any malady... for a price.

enrichment.description: Kuroo Hazama, also known as "Black Jack," is a legend in the medical world. Famous for being one of the best, as well as not having a license, Hazama and his assistant Pinoko save countless lives that other doctors cannot... for a price; an exorbitant price, in fact, which causes many to view the genius as greedy and heartless. Despite these claims, however, none can deny his skill and the lengths that he will go to treat his patients. This dark medical drama tells the story of the ominous and mysterious world of underground medicine as Black Jack risks his life to cure some of the most bizarre diseases imaginable, even if it means breaking every law in the process.

391.summary: Seiran Island, the tropical remote island, is home to Junnosuke Tachibana and his young sister, Asane, who return here from the mainland as a result of their parents' death. However, Seiran Island has become a dystopia where, to stop the decline of population, authorities have enforced the "Pervert Law." Sex is permitted and encouraged anywhere on the island, and those who refuse any sexual acts will be punished as a criminal offense. Being a cherry-picker who takes pride in his virginity, Junnosuke is skeptical about the law, thus, he sets up an anti-mating force, NLNS (No Love No Sex) to protect himself and his innocent sister, making headway to destroy the perverted law!

enrichment.description: On Seiran Island, secret society NLNS is united by Junnosuke Tachibana, who is determined to crush a law. They have found a benefactor, an unknown rich man, who offers them a secret base and cash. Their mission is to locate a mysterious girl and stop the law, keeping the SHO off their trail.

355.name: HYAKKO
355.summary: Newly joined Torako is an extraordinary high school girl. But it's not only Torako who is extraordinary, there are 3 more girls who joined the school on the same day as Torako, and they are equally unique in their own way! With Torako and her friends, the school days are never be the same everyday. Though their school days are like roller coaster, their friendship is something that does not change.

An anime adaptation produced by Nippon Animation was first aired in October 2008 in Japan. An OVA was released on October 17, 2009.

366.name: Negima!?(OVA)
366.summary: It's another world of Negima!? packed with Asuna and the others in sexy swimsuits! Those who like each other are bound by a red thread...  A heart-pounding story of red thread-related incidents!

enrichment.description: Wizard Negi Springfield may be a boy, but he has a man-sized job to do! Fresh from the Academy of Magic, Negi continues his training as an instructor at Mahora Academy in Japan. But before he can get his Master’s in magic, the 31 schoolgirls of Class 3-A are gonna keep him up all night cramming for a final exam in will power. Temptation aside, Negi has more on his syllabus than flirting and spells. Darkness is closing in, and Negi is gonna need help from his student bodies to drive the ghouls from their school. These girls want to prove that they’re best in class, and extra credit is available to the cuties that aren’t afraid of after hours phantom fighting – especially if it means more time with their favorite professor.

370.summary: The popular game created by minori, "Wind -a breath of heart-", has finally been made into an anime!!! Kazane City exudes a sense of nostalgia and mystery. It's the hometown of the siblings, Makoto and Hinata Okano. There, they meet their friends, a girl they grew up with, and then...

enrichment.description:
Okano Makoto transferred to the school in his home town. There, he spent normal but happy school days with his sister, Hinata, a jokey classmate, Tachibana Tsutomu, Shikouin Kasumi, Tsutomu's childhood friend, and other friends.

One day, after school, Makoto heard someone playing the harmonica. That melody made him feel something old, and it brought him to the roof of the school buildings. There, he met a girl in the dusk.

It was Narukaze Minamo who turned her face to him with a smile. She was a childhood friend, but they had lived separately for years.

Hiding their true thoughts, Makoto and his friends spend their lives in school. Their stories in a mysterious town are about to begin.

365.name: Haigakura
365.summary: An imprisoned family and lost past— To reclaim what matters most, the battle begins for the Kashi, Ichiyo and his subordinate god, Tenko! The Immortal Realm — the world where immortals and humans coexist stood on the brink of collapse. The singer Ichiyo and his subordinate god, Tenko, seek the Four Fiends — the malevolent gods holding the key to salvation. Each harbor their own secret purpose as they hunt down the Four Fiends. With an imprisoned family and a lost past, Ichiyo and Tenko race across the world to reclaim what matters most. Based on Shinobu Takayama's long-running popular comic, this action fantasy depicts the battle between the Kashi, Ichiyo and his subordinate god, Tenko!

enrichment.anilist_description: Nozomu wants to be a writer, but for now she's just trying to find the right story. Walking home from school one day she bumps into some guys, and even though it's an accident, they hassle her until she is saved by a mysterious man. His name is Ichiyou, and he is searching for Gods. Nozomu sends him along his way only to be approached by Tenkou, who is searching for his Master. Nozomu reunites Ichiyou and Tenkou; (and their abusive relationship), and gets a view of another world. The two men are on a journey to find the Gods. The world that was once supported by four evil Gods, has fallen to a crisis. Using song and dance, it is up to the kashikans to bring back the Gods which fled from their confinement…
enrichment.description: The story is set in a secluded realm where deities and mortals both dwell. A youth named Ichiyō sets out to capture the gods who have fled and scattered all over the realm. Together with the subordinate god Tenkō, Ichiyō seeks the four evil gods who hold the key to the realm's collapse.

354.name: Gonna be the Twin-Tail!!
354.japanese: 俺、ツインテールになります
354.summary: "To protect Earth, I'll become a twin tail!" Soji Mitsuka is an ordinary high school student with an obsessive love for twin tails. One day, a mysterious beautiful girl named Twoearle, who claims to have come from another world, appears before him. At the same time, monsters appear in the town where Soji lives! "All the twin tails in the world shall be ours!" The monsters are beings from another world who feed on people's emotional energy, known as "Attribute Strengths". Entrusted by Twoearle with the Tail Gear—an imaginary armor activated by the powerful Twin Tail Attribute—Soji transforms into the twin-tailed warrior girl, Tailred! From this day on, the insane battle between Tailred and the perverts begins!

enrichment.description: Souji Mitsuka is a first-year high school student who is obsessed with twin-tails. One day, a beautiful girl from a parallel world named Twoearle,  suddenly appeared in front of him and gave him the power to transform into the twin-tailed warrior Tail Red. With the Ultimegil organization attacking the planet, Souji now must fight in order to protect the peace on Earth.

369.name: Guardian Hearts
369.summary: One day, a girl appears out of the blue—turns out she's a super clumsy heroine, and an alien to boot! From then on, one troublesome alien beauty after another start showing up... Original work by Sae Amatsu! A chaotic, all-girl romantic comedy!

enrichment.description: Maya, Kurusu, and Chelsea hit it off really well when trying to get revenge on Guardian Hearts for making them suffer. Maya and company thought that Guardian Hearts usually appears when Kazuya is getting along with a girl. Not knowing that Guardian Hearts is actually Hina, they leave her alone with Kazuya in an attempt to lure out Guardian Hearts.

372.name: [Dub] Henkei Shoujo
372.summary: What would you do if a girl close to you suddenly morphs into a vehicle? A never-before-seen characterization of beautiful girls that entirely change form! Check out each episode for more details!

enrichment.description: Shorts about girls who transform into machines. The first episode focuses on Haru, a girl who transforms into a fighter jet while trying to catch a hat blowing away in the wind.

350.name: PandoraHearts
350.summary: During the coming-of-age ceremony for Oz (heir to the Vessalius family), “the messenger from the Abyss” suddenly appears and casts Oz into a prison called “the Abyss (in a different dimension)” for the crime of which he knows nothing about. Wandering in the darkness of Abyss, Oz meets a mysterious girl named Alice who is also known as B-rabbit. Alice is one of the “Chains” in the Abyss and she is a black rabbit in Chain form. In order to leave the Abyss, she was waiting for Oz who will be her human contractor. What is Oz’s crime? What is Alice’s intention? Their fate starts to unfold.

enrichment.description: Oz Vessalius, heir to one of the duke houses, has just turned fifteen. His life is rich and carefree, darkened only by the constant absence of his father. At his coming-of-age ceremony, however, everything changes. For no reason that he can discern, he's cast into the prison known as the "Abyss", only to be saved by a "chain" known as Alice, the bloodstained black rabbit. It is unknown why was he cast into Abyss, how does Alice factor into it all, and what does the organization known as "Pandora" want with him.

353.name: Scum's Wish
353.summary: Hopeless love. Heartbreaking love. Unrequited love. Is it really something so beautiful? Second-year high school student Hanabi Yasuraoka is tormented by a love that cannot be. It's a warmth she's willing to do anything to embrace, even if it means hurting herself and the people she cares about. This is a love story both profoundly pure and twisted.

enrichment.description: Seventeen-year-old Mugi Awaya and Hanabi Yasuraoka appear to be the ideal couple. They are both pretty popular, and they seem to suit each other well. However, outsiders don't know of the secret they share. Both Mugi and Hanabi have hopeless crushes on someone else, and they are only dating each other to soothe their loneliness. Mugi is in love with Akane Minagawa, a young teacher who used to be his home tutor. Hanabi is also in love with a teacher, a young man who has been a family friend since she was little. In each other, they find a place where they can grieve for the ones they cannot have, and they share physical intimacy driven by loneliness. Will things stay like this for them forever?

342.name: HEAD START AT BIRTH - Season 2
342.summary: Season 2!! A new cheat game story of Lilia, the Marchioness's daughter, who is an incredible genius in every way from handling magic to domain management. Carrying memories of her past life at birth, she is eager to get ahead of the game when she discovers magic exists in her reincarnated life. Despite being a 0-year-old who can only crawl, Lilia starts raising her level with full vigor. Eventually, she masters advanced magic by the age of five, as well as control high-level spirits and manage the domain. Using cheat codes, as if this world were a role-playing game or cattle ranch game, she inevitably receives attention from the royal family, and gets invited to the palace on her birthday. But alas, could this world foreshadow a romance game where she must become a villainess that has a political marriage with one of the princes?! Hell no!!!!

352.name: Does it Count if You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?
352.romaji: Andoroido wa keiken ninzu ni hairimasuka??
352.summary: Akane Tsuda (28), working at a major electronics manufacturer, impulsively buys something while drunk—something that guarantees a felony just for possession!? It was Nadeshiko, an illegally manufactured adult romance android!? Akane finds herself at Nadeshiko's mercy, but despite being toyed with, she's drawn to Nadeshiko's various impressive skills...? The single office lady and the android begin their naughty cohabitation life together!!

enrichment.description: Office Lady Tsuda Akane, age 28, seems like she's got it all together. Beautiful, brainy, and an indispensable office worker for a robotics manufacturer, Akane's admired at work...because her colleagues can't see her at home. Privately, Akane's a hot mess with an apartment that looks more like a landfill than a living space. Good thing she drunkenly ordered a new android named Nadeshiko to help her clean up! Well, maybe not good, because the beautiful lady android that arrives is a horny hottie. Akane's about to get more service than she expected!

352.japanese: アンドロイドは経験人数に入りますか？？（OA)

349.name: I’ll Live a Long Life to Dote on My Favorite Stepbrother!
349.romaji: Saioshino gikei wo mederu tame, nagaiki shimasu!
349.japanese: 最推しの義兄を愛でるため、長生きします！
349.summary: Alba has been reincarnated as the son of an impoverished noble family. When his mother remarried into a dukedom, he was introduced to his stepbrother, Orsis, his "favorite person" from his previous life. “Does this mean my favorite is now my stepbrother?” he thought joyfully, but he suddenly remembered that he was the reason his beloved stepbrother lost his smile… To avoid his impending fate and continue loving his favorite, Alba will do everything in his power to twist fate! This popular series, which has sold over 170,000 copies, tells a warm and touching story of a boy's reincarnated life in another world!

enrichment.anilist_description:
The story of Saioshi no Gikei wo Mederu Tame, Nagaikishimasu! follows the struggle of a player to protect his favorite character, who gets reincarnated as his older brother-in-law in a simulation raising game - however, the player is reincarnated as the younger brother who was meant to die.

(Source: Anime News Network)

This popular series, which has sold over 170,000 copies, brings you a warm and touching story story of a boy's reincarnated life in another world!

304.name: Aoihana
304.summary: Fumi Manjoume enters Kamakura's accelerated high school - Matsuoka All-Girls High School. While waiting at the Kamakura station on the day of her entrance ceremony, she runs into an old childhood friend whom she had not seen in 10 years: Akira Okudaira. In the new school, Fumi meets new classmates, and she starts to have affection towards her senior at school. At the same time, the friendship with Akira is rekindled and they begin to fall back into the rhythm of friends again. When their paths meet along the days of youth, it unfolds a delicate love story.

As their friendship is rekindled and they start falling back into the  rhythm of friends again, it starts a delicate love story...

346.name: [Dub] Ichigo Aika: Strawberry Elegy
346.romaji: Ichigo aika ~ zatsu de namaiki na aitsu to warikirenai ore ~
346.summary: My step-sister from Dad's remarriage was a hardcore gal—the complete opposite of me...! Even after moving in together, Aika keeps bringing guys home and doing whatever she wants, driving Kota crazy. But after a certain incident, she starts demanding hugs from him, and more...!? A bumpy step-sibling romance comedy between a sassy gal and a nit-picky, straight-laced step brother bursts onto the scene!

enrichment.description: The story centers on a pair of stepsiblings. When Kōta's father gets remarried, Kōta's first impression of his new stepsister Aika is that she is beautiful, but that image is shattered pretty quickly. His new stepsister is a super sassy and foul-mouthed gyaru who behaves uncontrollably while their parents are away, making Kōta's life a living hell. However, their relationship begins to change when Aika gradually warms up to Kōta's caring older-brother nature.
enrichment.anilist_description:
Kouta's world just got turned upside down. His dad's remarriage meant a new stepsister, Aika, and from their first encounter, it's clear she's everything he isn't. By day, Aika effortlessly plays the "perfect angel" for her parents, but behind closed doors, she's a cheeky teenager, a complete mismatch for Kouta. Their personalities clash violently, sparking arguments the moment their eyes meet. They might just be the world's worst siblings, locked in a constant battle of wills. Despite an incredibly rocky start, a subtle shift begins. Beneath Aika's wild exterior, a flicker of interest starts to grow for her caring brother.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on December 12th, 2025. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

346.japanese: イチゴ哀歌～雑で生イキな妹と割り切れない兄～（OA)(Dub)

348.name: [Dub] Ren Arisugawa Is Actually a Girl
348.romaji: Arisugawa Ren tte honto wa onna nandayone.
348.summary: A secret that could shake the entire entertainment industry— This sweet and innocent rom-com is a long-time bestseller! Kyohei's one and only claim to fame? Being cousins with Ren Arisugawa, an ultra-popular male idol. The two haven’t seen each other since they were kids, but out of the blue, Ren suddenly shows up to crash at Kyohei’s rundown apartment. But when Kyohei playfully tries to sneak a peek while Ren’s changing, he makes a shocking discovery! Ren is actually a girl in disguise! Now holding a scandalous secret that could rock the showbiz world, Kyohei finds himself forced into becoming Ren’s personal assistant to keep up the act…! Caught in a world of secrets and scandals, can the two keep their forbidden relationship under wraps in the wild world of showbiz?
