305.name: Thermae Romae
305.summary: Lucius is a public bathhouse architect in ancient Rome who is serious about his work, nearly to a fault, but loses his job after refusing to change with the times. At the invitation of a friend, the depressed Roman stops by a bathhouse, where he’s suddenly catapulted through time and space to a public bath in modern-day Japan. Lucius is shocked by the bath culture of the “flat-faced tribe” (Japanese), but upon returning to ancient Rome, he causes a great stir by employing their ideas. The architect becomes quite good at time-traveling back and forth, and before long, achieves fame in Rome as a bathhouse engineer, but…

enrichment.description: The story is a comedy about Lucius, an architect of public bath houses in ancient Rome, who time-travels to various modern-day baths in Japan. The author explores the two cultures in the world "that have loved baths the most: the Japanese and the Romans."

326.name: [Dub] Negima!?
326.summary: Negi Springfield is a ten-year-old boy who graduated from a magic school in Wales, UK, and became an apprentice wizard. Aspiring to become a Magister Magi—a top-tier wizard like his father—he is sent to Mahora Academy in Japan for training. Mahora Academy is a massive campus city with over 30,000 students. Its vast grounds house every educational facility imaginable, from university to kindergarten, along with student dorms, a hospital, restaurants, and even a huge arcade. Negi becomes the homeroom teacher for Class 2-A in the girls' middle school division. Immediately, the girls in his class start treating him like a child, calling him “Kid Teacher.” To make matters worse, despite there being a severe punishment if he reveals himself as a magician, Asuna Kagurazaka, one of his students, nearly suspects his true identity on his very first day. Then, as there are no vacant rooms, he ends up sharing a dorm room with Asuna and Konoka Konoe in the girls' dormitory! And to top it all off, a mysterious Dracula incident occurs. Can Negi Sensei earn the trust of his students who he's now forced to fight for? And can he overcome this trial to become a “Magister Magi” like his father?

enrichment.description: Vampires, robots, sorcery… And that’s all before Gym Class! Welcome to Mahora Academy, an all-girls school where the impossible and the enchanting are a part of the curriculum. It’s the start of the new school year and emotions run rampant as the girls of Class 2-A meet the newest staff addition – Negi Springfield. A ten-year-old Welsh born prodigy, Negi has more problems than he has students. As a wizard-in-training, this academic appointment is the final requirement in his quest to become a Magister Magorum. But if he messes things up and the girls find out, existence as an exotic ermine will be his fate!

311.romaji: Yami to boushi to hon no tabibito
311.japanese: ヤミと帽子と本の旅人
311.summary: Hazuki is a high-school student living with Hatsumi, and the two are so close they are like sisters.  When Hatsumi disappears, Hazuki moves heaven and earth to find her.

enrichment.description:
Hatsuki is a highschool student living with her sister, Hatsumi, who she has a huge crush on. On Hatsumi's 16th birthday, she is suddenly surrounded by a green light and disappears in front of Hatsuki!

She manages to follow Hatsumi with the help of a being resembling a fat baby chick (literally), ending up in a place called "The Great Library", which is full of different worlds stored in books. Hatsumi wasn't there, though, so the search for Hatsuki's great love begins and involves traveling from book to book.

309.name: [Dub] Kite: Liberator
309.japanese: カイト リベレイター(Dub)
309.summary: A teenage assassin is cleaning up the grimy streets of Tokyo.  This notorious hitman is actually a polite young lady.  Could the placid face of an innocent high school girl really disguise such a ruthless killer?

enrichment.description: Sawa may seem innocent and naive, but don’t be fooled. She is a cold-blooded killer, and if you’re on the wrong side of the law, you may be her next target. Not content to just watch as the imperfect justice system lets more and more criminals go loose every day, a detective decides to train the young Sawa to be his instrument of justice.

344.name: Blue Miburo Season 2
344.summary: It's the Bakumatsu Period. In the turbulent streets of Kyoto a young group of men gather. The Mibu Roshigumi, commonly known as "Miburo." Those that will become the Shinsengumi risk their lives to protect the peace of the city. When a kind-hearted boy named Nio joins the Miburo, their bonds are tested through days filled with battle. "To protect Kyoto, we must first abandon complacency and move forward anew." Inspired by Nio's words, the Miburo recruit new comrades and set out to expand their organization. However, the presence of Serizawa Kamo, the chief commander, threatens to create rifts within the ranks. As irreconcilable ideals of justice collide, a fleeting assination attempt is set into motionー. Blue MiburoーThe Serizawa Assassination Arcーbegins!

enrichment.description: The year is 1863, with the story being based in Kyoto. We follow a youth named Nio who is an honest and kind soul who's considerate of his family, yet he also has a hidden burning passion for seeking justice. From the time he came across Toshizou Hijikata and Souji Okita, members from a group of hated ronin known as the Miburo, his life then takes a turn to a bluer, and clearer path. Nio, alongside the other men whose hearts burn bravely and true, step forth towards an honest path with their blue wills adorned on their hearts!

While running each other ragged, the two of them gradually grow into a “family”. This is the long-awaited anime version of “Bunny Drop”, the extremely popular and finely crafted comic by Yumi Unita. It’s a heartwarming and entertaining work that naturally depicts child-raising experiences, but also the instantly relatable warmth and noise of being in a family.

Everybody in Daikichi's family looks at the girl as an embarrassment and wants no part of her. Disgusted by his family's attitude, Daikichi decides to raise Rin by himself, even though he has no experience raising a child and is still single.

322.summary: The Black Ships arrive in Kyoto as the shogunate stumbles toward ruin. Living amidst the chaos is Nio, a kindhearted boy on the verge of discovering his destiny. He meets two “Miburo,” Hijikata Toshizo and Soji Okita, the clan members of Mibu ronin who will later become the famous Shinsengumi. With dreams of a better world, Nio joins their fight to defend Kyoto. The long-awaited anime adaptation of the popular manga series is finally here!

We follow a youth named Nio who is an honest and kind soul who's considerate of his family, yet he also has a hidden burning passion for seeking justice. From the time he came across Toshizou Hijikata and Souji Okita, members from a group of hated ronin known as the Miburo, his life then takes a turn to a bluer, and clearer path. Nio, alongside the other men whose hearts burn bravely and true, step forth towards an honest path with their blue wills adorned on their hearts!

289.name: Antique Bakery
289.japanese: 西洋骨董洋菓子店〜アンティーク 〜
289.summary: One day, Keiichiro Tachibana opens a cake shop, where a gifted pâtissier named Ono appears before him. Back in high school, Tachibana harshly turned down Ono’s confession of love. Fortunately for Tachibana, Ono doesn’t remember him, and he manages to convince Ono to join the shop. However, Ono has since grown into an openly gay man with irresistible charm—and he soon begins to seduce Tachibana in unexpected ways… Set in the cake shop “Antique,” the story follows four handsome men: Tachibana, the owner; Ono, the talented pâtissier; Eiji, a former boxer; and Chikage, the waiter. Blending comedy with darker undertones, this character-driven story weaves together Tachibana’s unresolved childhood trauma, Ono’s dangerous charisma, and the sweets that bring them together.

enrichment.description: Antique Bakery is a small bakery that's run by four handsome men. Tachibana the owner, Chikage the one who was sent to watch over his childhood friend, Ono the "demonically charming" master pastry chef, and Kanda a former boxer.

300.name: Mazinkaiser SKL
300.japanese: マジンカイザースカル
300.summary: A lawless prison island, junkyard of robot machine super weapons from a forgotten age of massive military might, floats behind a gravity curtain.  Upon receiving a warning that the unstable island’s reactors will detonate and possibly vaporize the world in just a few days, the Japanese government awakens Kaiser, the most powerful and destructive robot ever created! Judgment day has arrived when the towering Kaiser rockets off to the island to engage in a thunderous robot-crushing battle to save the planet!

303.summary: A dramatic sci-fi love story that captures the lives of hopeful trainee pilots with refreshing charm and delicate yet dynamic visuals!

302.name: Kanokon: The Girl Who Cried Fox
302.summary: Kouta, a country boy, just recently relocated to the city, is dragged into supernatural events as a result of his contact with two girls, one who gives "foxy" new meaning and another howling after him.  Things are looking up for his love life.

enrichment.description:
Kouta has girl troubles of the supernatural sort. For some reason, he keeps attracting the attention (and affections) of animal spirits!

Having spent most of his life in the country, Kouta is understandably nervous when he moves in with his grandma to attend a high school in the big city. He hoped to make a good impression, but having Chizuru, a beautiful fox spirit, hanging off his arm didn't seem to be the sort of image he wanted to have. She's not alone in her love for Kouta, either. Nozomu, a wolf spirit, as well as other youkai have their sights set on the hapless country boy.

enrichment.description: Rushuna is a very beautiful gun expert that travels through the world with one purpose which is to make the world a peaceful place by, instead of fighting with weapons, taking away the people's will to fight by giving them a smile. In this quest she meets Yajirou, a mercenary that joins her on the journey.

294.summary: The friendship of high school boys can be a unique and oftentimes surreal existence for outsiders looking in. Of course, the friendship between our protagonists Ishida and Asakura, are no different. Join these two crazy characters as they get into all sorts of hilarious antics this winter season!

enrichment.description: Ishida & Asakura focuses on the title characters—the stoic Ishida and the lecherous Asakura—and the bizarre students and teachers that populate their high school. Asakura is obsessed with curvaceous women and dreams of becoming a teacher in order to be surrounded by attractive girls all day. Ishida dreams of running a flower shop together with Asakura after they finish high school, and appears to have strong homosexual feelings for his best friend, although this is always played for laughs.

293.name: Doomed Megalopolis
293.summary: Evil wizard Kato is obsessed with conquering Tokyo; however, when one of his dark spells awakens Masakato, Tokyo's legendary guardian, Kato realizes that his power is minuscule.  In an effort to control Masakato, Kato impregnates a young woman, hoping to produce an offspring with the power to subdue the beast. However, as Masakato turns his rage on of Tokyo and a band of clever citizens begins to discover Kato's plot, the wizard's plans spiral out of control threatening to destroy not only himself, but all of Tokyo.

enrichment.description: A spiritual battle is being waged within the capital of Tokyo during the turn of the 20th century. In 1908, Japan is undergoing an enormous process of industrial renovation due the influence of radical western ideals. Technology and politics shift the country's emphasis more and more away from the traditions of the past, with Tokyo being the main center of this radical movement. At the same time, Yasumasa Hirai, an Onmyoji of the Tsuchimikado Family, has been called from Kyoto to Tokyo in order to participate in a secret meeting concerning plans to turn Tokyo into the most commercial and blessed city in all of Japan. Opposing Hirai is Yasunori Kato, an evil Onmyoji whose only desire is the complete destruction of Tokyo. Yasumasa Hirai and Kato Yasunori meet and fight for the future of Tokyo and the Japanese Empire.

290.summary: Negi Springfield is a child prodigy who safely graduates the Magic Academy. In order to become a grand wizard, "Magister Magi", Negi becomes a teacher at the Mahora Academy in Japan. But before he can get his Master’s in magic, the 31 schoolgirls of Class 3-A are gonna keep him up all night cramming for a final exam in will power. These girls want to prove that they’re best in class, and extra credit is available to the cuties that aren’t afraid of after hours phantom fighting – especially if it means more time with their favorite professor.

277.name: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress
277.summary: As an industrial revolution swept across the globe and society was shifting from the early modern era into modernity, immortal monsters suddenly appeared. Unless their iron-clad hearts were pierced, they could not be destroyed, and anyone bitten by them would die, only to rise again as one of their kind. These creatures, later known as Kabane, multiplied rapidly and engulfed the world. In the Far Eastern island nation of Hinomoto, people survived by shutting themselves inside fortresses called “stations.” The only means of travel between them was armored steam locomotives known as Hayajiro, which carried goods to sustain life. At Aragane Station lived a young steamsmith named Ikoma, who worked with steel and steam engines. Longing for the day he could prove himself, he secretly developed a weapon of his own—the Piercing Gun—to defeat the Kabane. One day, the armored train Kotetsujo (the Iron Fortress), a Hayajiro, broke through the front lines and arrived at Aragane Station. While assigned to clean the carriages, Ikoma noticed a mysterious girl named Mumei who was strangely excused from the mandatory Kabane inspection. That night, when he encountered her again, a Hayajiro went berserk and crashed into the station—its crew had all perished and turned into Kabane! As Kabane flooded Aragane Station and panic spread, Ikoma defied the fleeing crowd and ran straight toward the horde. This time, he would not run away. With his Piercing Gun in hand, he vowed to strike the Kabane down once and for all. Thus began Ikoma’s battle—to become a man who truly shines.

enrichment.description: In the midst of an industrial revolution, the people of Hinomoto fight hordes of undead creatures, known as Kabane, using powerful armored trains.

276.name: C
276.summary: The world of Kimimaro Yoga is no different than ordinary Japan, 2011.  An economics major but with no ambisions, he hopes for nothing more than to live a mediocre life. But his world changes one day when a shady man by the name of Masakaki turns up with a proposal for Yoga on behalf of the Bank of Midas-- “This bank will lend funds using your future abilities as collateral.  Will you use your present abilities to invest it?”　Despite the fear of loosing, Yoga finds himself led by Masakaki to... the Financial District.  Once he is enlisted as an “Entrepeneur”, Yoga realizes that he is an executive Player, along with his Asset Mashu, and they must now battle through trading and invest in order to keep afloat in the Game, not to loose their entire future!

That night, Haruaki wakes up to a suspicious noise in the kitchen, and he discovers a fully naked female thief of rice crackers. The girl, Fear, is the first of several surprises that Haruaki receives.

258.name: I Have No Money!
258.summary: Yukiya Ayase, a beautiful boy who was put up for auction to pay off his cousin's debt, was bought off by Kita Kano, the president of a financial company. In exchange for his freedom, Ayase now has to pay back the amount he was auctioned for, plus his cousin's debt, totaling 200 million yen. At a loss with no source of income, Kano offers him a suggestion… Why did Kano make a bid on Ayase? A bittersweet, clumsy love story begins…

enrichment.description: Kentaro lives in the suburbs with his two little brothers. They are poor, but they are happy. The factory Kentaro works for, though, goes bankrupt on pay day and Kentaro finds himself out of a job and with even less money. The brothers are thrown out of their apartment and Kentaro, a born optimistic until then, decides that he must aggressively pursue "money". This drama depicts the success story of Kentaro in his search for money and a better life.
enrichment.anilist_description:
Yukiya Ayase is a gentle, kind hearted, and innocent university student. The only relative he has left, his cousin Tetsuo, betrays Ayase by selling him to the highest bidder in an auction with hopes of making an enormous profit to be able to pay off his debts. Somuku Kanou, a bad-tempered (though very rich) loan shark, comes to Ayase's rescue and buys Ayase for an impressive 1.2 billion. Kanou apparently knows Ayase from something that happened between them in the past, but Ayase cannot remember who Kanou is nor does he understand why he "saved" him. In a desperate effort to keep Ayase close to him, Kanou demands the debt be repaid in full and suggests the perfect way to do it: by selling his body to Kanou for 500,000 each time. Ayase is horrified in the beginning, but something soon begins to grow between them that can't be bought for any price.

(Source: Anime News Network)

272.name: Punchline
272.summary: Glimpsing panties means the extinction of the human race?! High school student Yuta Iridatsu has an unfortunate, idiosyncratic condition. Seeing a girl’s panties gets him so excited that he faints. Certain circumstances cause Yuta to have an out-of-body experience, which he takes advantage of by peeping on the fellow residents of his apartment building and stopping time to play silly pranks. But in the end, will all of the residents work together to save the world?!

enrichment.description: High schooler Yūta Iridatsu has experienced “astral projection” i.e. his spirit has been separated from his body. He woke up in a mansion named Koraikan and met a cat spirit named Chiranosuke, who told him “You must find the Sacred Tome of Koraikan in order to return to your physical body.” While searching through corridors of Koraikan, Yūta bumped into underpants of its female residents, and doing so would, eh, create some big trouble for planet Earth.

247.name: [Dub] Adam's Sweet Agony
247.summary: This is the story of Adam, a boy among four billion Eves. In a world where a pandemic has rendered all men impotent, high school student Itsuki is the exception who escaped it. As he must protect this secret, he is transferred to a very special school, which turns out to be a high school composed of 90% girls.

enrichment.description: This is the story of a boy, who became the lone Adam among four billion Eves. In a world where a pandemic has rendered all men impotent, high school student Itsuki is the exception who escaped it. In order to protect this secret, he transfers to a very special high school, which turns out to be composed of 90% girls! There, he encounters an upbeat and friendly senior, a sexually frustrated female teacher, a tomboyish school 'prince,' and an heiress from a wealthy family. For Itsuki, who has his pick of any woman in the world, the question remains: which one will he choose?

"Why do you have an erection...? You're sneaky."

In a world where all humans have suffered from ED due to a pandemic, Kazuki, a male student, is the only special person who has escaped ED. In order to keep the secret, he transferred to a harem school full of women!? A kind and friendly senior, a frustrated female teacher, the school's prince, the daughter of a wealthy family, and more.

What will Kazuki, who can captivate any woman, choose?

243.name: The Winter Cicada
243.summary: Based on the past life edition of Iwaki and Kato in "Embracing Love: Cherished Spring," here is an anime adaptation of the paths Akizuki and Kusaka followed as they lived through the turmoil of the Meiji Restoration. It was the end of the Edo period, a turbulent time. A Choshu samurai, Toma Kusaka meets a Tokugawa vassal, Keichiro Akizuki. They feel a deep attraction towards each other, but the times simply do not allow it.

enrichment.description: Iwaki Kyousuke and Katou Yoji are two hugely popular adult film stars looking for a way out of the industry. Their chance arrives when they’re both invited to audition for a new erotic film. Imagine their surprise when the director decides the only way for him to choose who will get the coveted lead role is for them to perform one of the film’s love scenes on the spot—with each other! Things get even crazier when Katou decides to take drastic measures to ensure he can continue seeing Iwaki after film production wraps. How will Iwaki respond to Katou’s impulsive act?
enrichment.anilist_description:
If time did not allow ordinary things to be ordinary. How would you have lived?
It is the Bakamatsu and early Meiji Period. Akizuki Keiichirou and Kusaka Touma stand of opposite sides of the political scale of the time but still, something as fragile as the shell of a cicada binds these two men together in a tragic and cruel fate. A story of friendship, love and seperation as well as reunion and sacrifice.
(Source: AniDB)

242.name: This Boy Can Fight Aliens
242.summary: The aliens have suddenly invaded the world. Kakashi, a high schooler and the only one able to fight aliens, gets found unconscious on a hill by Arikawa, a member of the Special Alien Countermeasures HQ. Arikawa and his boss, Shiro, take him under their wing and they start living together. It's another day of battle for Kakashi, who, despite his memory loss, is fighting for his friends and family who are somewhere out there. With Arikawa watching over him protectively, and Shiro being the stern parent-like figure, he settles in well with the carrot and stick pair. However, circumstances take a sudden turn when Kakashi loses his will to fight and they grow apart...

enrichment.description: When unstoppable aliens invade, it seems that all is lost until a teenager with the ability to defeat these invaders appears, but he has no memories of who he is or how to use his power.

242.japanese: この男子、宇宙人と戦えます。

241.name: This Boy Picked Up A Merman
241.summary: Shima Kawauchi is a high schooler, bearing loneliness in his heart. While crying at the beach on the day he lost his grandfather, he ends up slipping and drowning, and gets rescued by a beautiful young man who was a merman! He names the merman Isaki, and they start living together. Despite getting bewildered by living with Isaki, Shima warms up to his kindness, and gradually comes out of his shell. As his loneliness fades from living a fulfilling life, the relationship between them starts to change...
241.japanese: この男子、人魚ひろいました。

227.name: [Dub] Chuhai Lips: Canned Flavor of Married Women
227.romaji: Hitozuma no kuchibiru wa kanchuhai no ajigashite
227.summary: If ever there was an opportunity to enjoy canned chuhai alone with 'that' married woman... Tsuyoshi is a college student living the lazy life. As he reaches for a canned chuhai to perk things up, a charming, married woman with a catch appears before him, and they have a drink together. As the two get closer and closer, skin to skin, no doubt something's bound to happen! An immoral anthology series mixed with married women and strong canned chuhai!

enrichment.description: The omnibus manga centers on college student Tsuyoshi, who loves drinking strong canned chu-hai, and his encounters with various married women.

227.japanese: 人妻の唇は缶チューハイの味がして(Dub)(OA)

225.name: [Unedited] I Tried Asking While Kowtowing
225.summary: Believe it or not, a short anime adaptation of Funatsukazuki’s popular doujin series is set for release!! Suwaru Doge just can't help but want to discover many things a girl has to offer. So his last resort to win them over is... that's right, "Kowtow." Suwaru Doge persistently kowtows until he gets the favor, troubling and embarrassing the girls with his abrupt conduct. Is there no limit to kowtowing?! Will all the girls expose themselves in the end?! Now everybody, "Let's Kowtow!!"

enrichment.description: "Grovel enough, and you'll get what you want."  This is the motto that Suwaru Doge firmly stands by, believing that kneeling and begging will grant him the majestic view of a woman's naked body. After realizing the power of groveling in the dogeza stance, Doge wastes no time in exploiting it for lewd requests. Targeting the cutest and hottest girls in the school, he is one step closer to his goal of beholding their nude bodies, no matter what harm it may cause to his social standing.

225.japanese: 本気で土下座で頼んでみた

221.summary: Chiharu Kashima is the wizard in charge of the magical crisis counter-measure division. His days are stressful until he meets Toyohi Utsumi at his favorite bar, and the two hit it off. The two begin a budding relationship, until an accident at work causes Chiharu to devote more time to his work, and begin to push Toyohi away...

231.name: NUKITASHI THE ANIMATION
231.summary: Seiran Island, the tropical remote island, is home to Junnosuke Tachibana and his young sister, Asane, who return here from the mainland as a result of their parents' death. However, Seiran Island has become a dystopia where, to stop the decline of population, authorities have enforced the "Pervert Law." Sex is permitted and encouraged anywhere on the island, and those who refuse any sexual acts will be punished as a criminal offense. Being a cherry-picker who takes pride in his virginity, Junnosuke is skeptical about the law, thus, he sets up an anti-mating force, NLNS (No Love No Sex) to protect himself and his innocent sister, making headway to destroy the perverted law!

enrichment.description: On Seiran Island, secret society NLNS is united by Junnosuke Tachibana, who is determined to crush a law. They have found a benefactor, an unknown rich man, who offers them a secret base and cash. Their mission is to locate a mysterious girl and stop the law, keeping the SHO off their trail.

222.name: This Boy Suffers From Crystallization
222.summary: Ayumu Tamari suffers from Crystallization Syndrome, a crippling illness which causes his body to start turning to crystals whenever he becomes anxious or depressed. He chases after the romantic affections of his teacher, Koya Onihara, who spurns him at every turn, unwilling to accept love from a student.

enrichment.description: Ayumu, struggling with a rare condition that turns him to stone, creates a new persona for himself, but his feelings grow for his teacher, Kouya, who sees beauty in his transformation.

222.japanese: この男子、石化に悩んでます。

220.name: [Dub] Marry Me, Let's Have a Baby!
220.summary: Please marry me with having a baby in mind! Here's the birth of an extraordinary contract marriage story about having a baby within a year! At the marriage hunting party, Taika hits it off with Ayano, who wants a child. However, Taika is actually impotent, and runs out midway through the party. One day, on his visit to the hospital for his ED treatment, he finds out that the doctor who is in charge is Ayano! From the original manga that gained popularity for its groundbreaking scenario!! Don't miss it!

enrichment.description: At a speed-dating event, Taika hits it off with a woman named Ayano, a doctor who’s eager to have children. However, just as the matching couples are about to be announced, he panics and makes a break for it when his fears about his erectile dysfunction begin to surface... Later, at an appointment for his condition, Taika is shocked to discover that his doctor is none other than Ayano herself! On top of that, he realizes that when he's with Ayano, his erectile dysfunction disappears! This is a story about two people who decide to enter into a secret contractual marriage with one goal, to have a child in less than a year!

198.name: [Dub] Isekai Onsen Paradise
198.summary: Kozo Yukawa loves hot springs! He’s a hot spring hunter that can sniff out the very source of them! One day, in an effort to bring notoriety to a small town, he goes out searching for a secret hot spring, when he slips off a cliff! After perishing in the fall, he is reincarnated into another world by a fox god. Kozo is not reincarnated alone, and is joined by the messenger princess of the fox god, Mayudama. Smelling the stinking, rotting egg smell of a nearby hot spring, he runs to jump in along with Mayudama. That’s when an elf girl appears… who proceeds to attack them! After resolving their differences, Kozo decides to spread the knowledge and wonders of hot springs throughout his new world! Encouraging people to take off their clothes, soak in the hot water, and heal the whole world!

enrichment.description: The story centers around Yoshizou Yukawa, a major hot spring fan who finds hidden springs to revitalize the economy of the local area. However, he dies after falling off a cliff and is transported to an alternate world, thanks to an inari deity of harvest at a small shrine nestled in the rocks. Together with the inari's attendant princess Mayudama, he continues searching for storied hot springs, only this time in the alternate world. Along the way, he ends up naked in hot springs with furry-eared girls and elven girls.

195.name: AD Police Files
195.summary: In MEGATOKYO 2027, AI androids called Boomers promise freedom from labor but bring danger. Three episodes set in the Bubblegum Crisis universe.

enrichment.description:
MegaTokyo 2027: Relentless technological development has resulted in the creation of Boomers.

These are artificially intelligent androids with the potential to free mankind from physical labor; but anything that can be used can also be misused.

194.name: [Dub] Bubblegum Crash
194.summary: The sequel to the smash hit Bubblegum Crisis! Times are changing, and boomers are now seen as the city's saviors. The Knight Sabers' leader Sylia suddenly disappears, leaving the team to go their separate ways. When a dangerous cabal of power-suited mercenaries start hunting for a revolutionary AI that's about to change the world, Sylia returns to outfit the girls with even badder hard suits.

enrichment.description:
MegaTokyo 2033: Tokyo was left flattened as a result from a great earthquake.

A new city, MegaTokyo, was then recreated due in no small part from the aid of a multi-million dollar company, Genom Corp. Genom created and mass-produced biomechanical creatures called Boomers to aid in the restoration of MegaTokyo.

When the Boomers began to run out of control, the ADPolice at first tried to stop them, but they proved to be far more difficult to deal with than was first imagined.

Under the ever looming Boomer threat, a group of four girls from varying degrees of society banded together. Calling themselves The Knight Sabers, they were the only ones with enough firepower and resourcefullness to defend the fledgling MegaTokyo from Genom and it's berserk Boomers.

190.name: Time Of Eve
190.summary: In the near future, two high school boys stumble upon a secluded café with one rule: robots and humans are to be treated as equals.

enrichment.description: The future, probably Japan. Robots have long been put into practical use, and androids have just come into use. Influenced by the Robot Ethics Committee, it's become common sense for people to treat androids like household appliances. Their appearance – indistinguishable from humans except for the ring over each android's head – has led some people to empathize unnecessarily with androids. Known as "android-holics", such people have become a social problem. Rikuo, a high school student, has been taught from childhood that androids are not to be viewed as humans, and has always used them as convenient tools. One day, Rikuo discovers some strange data in the behavior records of his family's household android, Sammy. Rikuo and his friend Masaki trace Sammy's movements, only to discover a mysterious café that features a house rule that "humans and robots are to be treated the same".

165.name: Simple yet Sexy
165.summary: Minimal makeup, messy hair, baggy clothes… There's nothing really attractive about Rena Yukuhashi. Ryohei Hachiya asks Rena out for dinner because his boss forces him to. He was expecting the dinner to be boring, but the girl who turned up was...?!
165.japanese: じみへんっ!!～地味子を変えちゃう純異性交遊～

168.name: 3 Seconds Later, He Turned Into a Beast
168.romaji: 3 byougo, yaju. ~ Goukon de sumi ni ita kare wa nikushoku deshita
168.summary: Freshly arrived in Tokyo, Tsumugi had only bad experiences with guys from the capital... Could it be that she had found the kind and serious boy she was looking for in Kaname? Or did she once again throw herself into the arms of a playboy...?

enrichment.description: Tsumugi is a female college student who carries trauma from an aggressive man in her past. She meets Kaname at a mixer she requested specifically for unaggressive "herbivore"-type men. She and Kaname hit it off, and Kaname resembles Tsumugi's older brother a little bit, so she relaxes her guard around him. Kaname, however, feigns to be a "herbivore"-type man, but is in reality an aggressive "carnivore"-type man, and he can change his demeanor in an instant.

168.japanese: ３秒後、野獣。～合コンで隅にいた彼は肉食でした（OA）

169.name: Married Couple Swap
169.summary: Reiji and his wife joined their friends on a getaway to a traditional Japanese inn, hoping to conceive a child. However, their plans took an unexpected turn when Reiji was seduced by his friend's wife, while his own wife engaged in a passionate affair with their mutual friend. Amidst forbidden desires and the thrill of pushing boundaries, the four of them delved deeper into temptation. As they surrendered to their carnal passions, could they ever reclaim the innocence of their marriages?

enrichment.anilist_description:
"Shall we join them?"
Reiji, accompanied by his wife Kanade and their close friends Kosuke and Asuka, had visited the inn for vacation. On the first day, during dinner, a heated argument broke out between the two couples, and Asuka dragged Reiji away to her room. But from inside, he could hear his wife Kanade's restless sighs...(Source: Coolmic)

Note: The complete edition with explicit scenes was distributed web via Comic Festa Anime Zone. The on-air version was broadcasted on Tokyo MX and BS11.

162.name: A Hot Night With My Boss in a Capsule Hotel
162.romaji: Shudengo, kapuseru hoteru de,  joushi ni binetsu tsutawaru yoru.
162.summary: In the capsule hotel with my boss...!? Minori and Hadano, the two who usually argue a lot, miss the last train together and end up spending a night in a capsule hotel. In a small capsule room, the two's temperature gets closer and... A love story starts from a capsule hotel...

enrichment.description: The anime centers on Minori, an office worker, and her boss Hadano, who are constantly arguing with each other. One night, after a company drinking party, Minori and Hadano are having their usual argument, when Minori realizes that she has missed the last train. They decide to spend the night at a nearby capsule hotel, but an incident forces them to share the same unit.  (Source: ANN)

162.japanese: 終電後､カプセルホテルで､上司に微熱伝わる夜｡(OA)

164.name: Crazy Over His Fingers
164.romaji: Ore no yubi de midarero. ~ Heitengo futarikiri no saronde... ~
164.summary: "Do my fingers turn you on?" Fumi works as an assistant at a popular salon in town. One of the top hairdressers, Sosuke, is her trainer. One day, during training, Fumi accidentally splashes water onto Sosuke... She thought that he would be angry, but...?! "Why can't I touch you?" She's charmed by his beautiful fingers...she can't deny him...
164.japanese: 俺の指で乱れろ。～閉店後二人きりのサロンで…～

163.name: Fire in His Fingertips -My Childhood Friend is a Fireman-
163.romaji: Yubisaki kara honki no netsujou -osananajimi wa shouboushi-
163.summary: Ryo's entire life changes after her apartment burns down. She starts living with her childhood friend, Souma, who actually saved her from the fire. Are all fire fighters just flirty? Or.. is this true love...? A story full of love, flirting, and muscles!!
163.japanese: 指先から本気の熱情-幼なじみは消防士-(OA)

161.name: Sweet Punishment - I'm the Guard's Personal Pet-
161.romaji: Amaichoubatsu ~ watashi wa kanshu sen'you petto
161.summary: Hina gets sent to the prison for a false charge. At the Kokuyoku Prison, awaiting was Aki Myojin. Here, everything Aki Myojin says is the law. "Don't you think you can get away from the Kokuyoku Prison". After being played around both her body and soul, what is going to happen with Hina?!

enrichment.description: The story is set in a prison in the near future. It revolves around Hina Saotome, imprisoned despite her innocence, and the elegant yet sadistic guard Aki Myoujin. Hina's heart and body are at the mercy of Myoujin's "heartless yet sweet domination" from physical examinations to lovers' prison visits.

161.japanese: 甘い懲罰～私は看守専用ペット(OA)

167.name: [Dub] Kakushite! Makina-san!
167.summary: Eita Akutsu is a loner and an introverted mecha otaku. One night, the cheerful and popular gyaru, Makina Agatsuma, suddenly appears in his apartment. But something seems off about her. When she abruptly strips in front of him… what he sees is not a human body, but a mechanical one! Makina is an AI robot designed for intimacy, yet she's been restricted from accessing any adult-related information. Eita, on the other hand, is a pure-hearted virgin who is extremely awkward with anything lewd. Thus begins their top-secret cohabitation, where no one must find out her true nature!
